user.title: Add Status Page
user.description: Enter the base URL of the status page you want to monitor (e.g. https://status.claude.com). The provider platform is detected automatically. Multiple pages can be added by repeating this step.

data_description.url: Base URL of the status page (without trailing slash).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for updates. Minimum 30 seconds, default 60 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the status page. Check your network connection and the URL.
error.invalid_url: Invalid URL. Make sure it starts with https:// or http://.
error.not_a_statuspage: No supported status page API found at this URL. Make sure the URL points to a compatible status page (e.g. Atlassian Statuspage).
error.timeout: Connection timed out. The server may be temporarily unavailable.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. See the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This status page is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for updates. Minimum 30 seconds, default 60 seconds.
